picks.title: Jesse Miettinen Released Damage Control, Powerful New Blender Toolkit
picks.excerpt: Jesse Miettinen has launched Damage Control, a Blender toolkit of interconnected generative tools (Smudge Mask Generator, Scatter Tools, Generative Tools, plus shaders and Mega Presets) to help artists scatter, smudge, and procedurally build more lifelike game environments faster.
picks.rationale: Concrete new tool a game artist can install tomorrow - a procedural/generative Blender toolkit that directly speeds environment craft.

picks.title: "It creates lesser games": Indie game studios are supposed to love generative AI, so why do the 25 devs I spoke to avoid it?
picks.excerpt: A reporter interviews 25 indie studios about why they avoid generative AI despite it being pitched as an indie accelerator, surfacing how AI actually fits (or fails to fit) into working game-design craft and production workflows.
picks.rationale: Freshest pick and original field reporting (25 studios) on where gen-AI really helps vs. hurts craft - kept over the same-study Steam-prediction piece.

picks.title: How to Build Scalable MetaHuman Crowds in Unreal Engine | Unreal Fest Chicago 2026
picks.excerpt: An Unreal Fest Chicago 2026 session on building scalable MetaHuman crowds in Unreal Engine with Mass and Nanite - a production pipeline for populating game worlds with AI-authored digital-human characters at scale.
picks.rationale: First-party Unreal Fest technique session - a repeatable production pipeline for AI-authored digital-human crowds designers can apply directly.
